baseline_demo.description: PARITY_001.pdf plus every unique stress fixture. Excludes PARITY_001.docx/.pptx: the PDF/DOCX/PPTX parity documents contain duplicate logical knowledge, so indexing all three together would distort retrieval scores.

parity_pdf.description: format_comparison: PARITY_001 rendered as PDF only. Never combined with parity_docx/parity_pptx into one index.

parity_docx.description: format_comparison: PARITY_001 rendered as DOCX only. Never combined with parity_pdf/parity_pptx into one index.

parity_pptx.description: format_comparison: PARITY_001 rendered as PPTX only. Never combined with parity_pdf/parity_docx into one index.
